Name: (JA) Green Cabbage
Author: MarcyTheBeast
Description:
[b][size=4]The almighty green cabbage![/size][/b]

[b]Update 1.1.2[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new recipe: Sauteed Cabbage
[*]Requires 2 cabbage leaves and 1 garlic to craft
[*]Recipe can be bought at the salloon for 300g



[/list]Green cabbage doesn't exist in Stardew Valley despite there being a red cabbage. This mod aims to fix that. You can buy the seeds from Pierre's starting from year 2. The cabbage takes 12 days to mature. A single leaf sells for 50g. You get 2-5 leafs from each harvest.

The cabbage leaf is classified as a vegetable. It can be pickled and you can make juice out of it as well.

For now the mod adds one recipe. I'm not sure whether or not I'll be adding any new ones.


Installation:

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.
[*]Install Json Assets.
[*]Unzip the mod.
[*]Put the mod in your mod folders.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
The mod should be compatible with any mod as long as it doesn't add items with the same name.

It's my first mod so if there's anything I can improve let me know!

Manifest.Name: (JA) Cabbage Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds green cabbage into the game. Available after year 1.
